data.desc: SkyWest, Inc. is the holding company for SkyWest Airlines, Inc., SkyWest Charter, LLC ('SWC') and SkyWest Leasing, Inc., an aircraft equipment leasing company. SkyWest Airlines has a fleet of approximately 500 aircraft connecting passengers to over 240 destinations throughout North America. SkyWest Airlines operates through partnerships with United Airlines, Delta Air Lines, American Airlines, and Alaska Airlines carrying more than 46 million passengers in 2025.
